examples.label: Scan, then try each app's well-known default credentials

notes: Default creds are the fastest win on enterprise apps: system:manager (Tomcat/JBoss), nagiosadmin:PASSW0RD, prtgadmin:prtgadmin, admin:changeme (Splunk). Always try these before exploiting.

recommended.note: ColdFusion admin panel is a prime default-cred target.

name: Other Notable Apps - Defaults and Exploit Paths
description: Quick reference for other common enterprise apps and their standard attack paths - default creds and the deploy/RCE primitive for each.

variations.label: Default creds
variations.command:
Tomcat:  tomcat/tomcat, admin/admin
Splunk:  admin/changeme
PRTG:    prtgadmin/prtgadmin
WebLogic: system/manager
Nagios:  nagiosadmin/PASSW0RD
